name: Array To String (Bool:Array)
description: Joins the elements of an array of booleans into a single string using a specified delimiter.

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Trigger to join the array elements.

inputs.name: Delimiter
inputs.description: Delimiter string to insert between array elements.

outputs.name: On Trigger
outputs.description: Triggers when the converted string is output.

name: Array To String (Int32:Array)
description: Joins the elements of an array of integers (Int32) into a single string using a specified delimiter.

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Trigger to join the array elements.

inputs.name: Delimiter
inputs.description: Delimiter string to insert between array elements.

outputs.name: On Trigger
outputs.description: Triggers when the converted string is output.

name: Array To String (Float:Array)
description: Joins the elements of an array of floats into a single string using a specified delimiter.

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Trigger to join the array elements.

inputs.name: Delimiter
inputs.description: Delimiter string to insert between array elements.

outputs.name: On Trigger
outputs.description: Triggers when the converted string is output.

name: Array To String (String:Array)
description: Joins the elements of an array of strings into a single string using a specified delimiter.

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Trigger to join the array elements.

inputs.name: Delimiter
inputs.description: Delimiter string to insert between array elements.

outputs.name: On Trigger
outputs.description: Triggers when the converted string is output.

name: Bool To Audio
description: Convert a boolean value (block rate) to audio signal (0 or 1).

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: Boolean input to convert to audio.

name: Clock Divider
description: Divide a trigger into eight density levels.

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Input trigger to the clock divider.

name: Delta Time
description: Outputs the elapsed time between consecutive triggers.

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Trigger input to calculate delta time.

inputs.name: Reset
inputs.description: Trigger input to reset the stored time without outputting a delta.

outputs.name: On Trigger
outputs.description: Trigger output when the delta time is calculated.

outputs.name: On Reset
outputs.description: Trigger output when the time is reset.

outputs.name: Delta
outputs.description: Time difference between consecutive triggers in seconds.

name: Dust
description: Generates randomly timed impulses (uni or bi-polar) alongside triggers, with optional audio-rate modulation.

inputs.name: Enabled
inputs.description: Enable or disable the dust node.

inputs.name: Bi-Polar
inputs.description: Toggle between bipolar and unipolar impulse output.

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.description: Seed for the random number generator (-1 uses the current time).

inputs.name: Density
inputs.description: Base density of impulses (roughly equivalent to Hz).

name: Edge
description: Detect upward and downward changes in an input audio signal.

inputs.name: In
inputs.description: Input audio to monitor for edge detection.

name: EDO
description: Generates a frequency based on equal division of the octave.

inputs.name: Divisions
inputs.description: Number of divisions of the octave (default is 12).

name: Impulse
description: Trigger a one-sample impulse (unipolar or alternating polarity per impulse).

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Trigger input to generate an impulse.

inputs.name: Bi-Polar
inputs.description: Toggle between bipolar and unipolar impulse output.

name: Phase Disperser
description: A chain of allpass filters acting as a phase disperser to soften transients.

inputs.name: Stages
inputs.description: Number of allpass filter stages to apply.

inputs.name: Maximum Stages
inputs.description: Upper bound on the number of filters (evaluated once on instantiation).

name: Shift Register
description: Shift register node with eight stages and additional reset/output options.

inputs.name: In
inputs.description: Input float to the shift register.

inputs.name: Reset
inputs.description: Reset trigger for the shift register.

inputs.name: Default
inputs.description: Default float for the shift register.

inputs.name: Reverse
inputs.description: Reverse flag for the shift register.

inputs.name: Output On Reset
inputs.description: When true, a reset will immediately output default values.

outputs.name: On Reset
outputs.description: Output trigger when Output On Reset is true.

name: Slew (Audio)
description: A slew rate limiter to smooth out the rise and fall times of an audio signal.

name: Slew (Float)
description: A slew limiter to smooth out the rise and fall times of a float value.

name: Stereo Balance
description: Adjusts the balance of a stereo signal with optional audio-rate modulation.

inputs.name: Balance
inputs.description: Balance control ranging from -1.0 (full left) to 1.0 (full right).

name: Stereo Crossfade
description: Crossfades between two stereo signals with optional audio-rate modulation.

inputs.name: Crossfade
inputs.description: Crossfade between the two inputs (0.0 to 1.0).

outputs.name: Out L
outputs.description: Left channel of the output signal.

outputs.name: Out R
outputs.description: Right channel of the output signal.

name: Stereo Gain
description: Scales a stereo input to a gain value with optional audio-rate modulation.

name: Stereo Inverter
description: Invert and/or swap stereo channels.

inputs.name: Invert L
inputs.description: Invert the polarity of the left channel.

inputs.name: Invert R
inputs.description: Invert the polarity of the right channel.

inputs.name: Swap L/R
inputs.description: Swap the left and right channels.

name: Stereo Width
description: Adjusts the stereo width of a signal with optional audio-rate modulation.

inputs.name: Width
inputs.description: Stereo width factor ranging from 0 to 200% (0 - 2).

outputs.name: Out L
outputs.description: Left channel of the adjusted stereo output signal.

outputs.name: Out R
outputs.description: Right channel of the adjusted stereo output signal.

name: Sum (Int32:Array)
description: Outputs the sum of all elements in the input array when triggered.

outputs.name: On Sum
outputs.description: Triggers when the sum is output.

outputs.name: Sum
outputs.description: The sum of the array elements.

name: Sum (Float:Array)
description: Outputs the sum of all elements in the input array when triggered.

outputs.name: On Sum
outputs.description: Triggers when the sum is output.

outputs.name: Sum
outputs.description: The sum of the array elements.

name: Sum (Time:Array)
description: Outputs the sum of all elements in the input array when triggered.

outputs.name: On Sum
outputs.description: Triggers when the sum is output.

outputs.name: Sum
outputs.description: The sum of the array elements.

name: Tuning
description: Generates a frequency based on custom tuning per-note.

inputs.name: Reference Frequency
inputs.description: Reference frequency in Hz (default is 440 Hz).

name: Tuning From Array
description: Generates a frequency based on custom tuning per-note, with array input.

inputs.name: Tuning Cents Array
inputs.description: Array of tuning adjustments in cents for each note in the octave.

name: Tuning To Frequency Array
description: Generates an array of frequencies based on custom tuning with cent values per-note.

name: Zero Crossing
description: Detect zero crossings in an input audio signal.

inputs.name: Signal
inputs.description: Input audio signal to monitor for zero crossings.
